summary: Upgrade the optional external Ord service to 0.29.0 with Bitcoin Core 31.1 qualification
details: Build Ord from the verified official 0.29.0 commit using a reviewed dependency lock and auditable services binary. Source-built USDB world-sim uses the same version and lock; the embedded Indexer parser is unchanged.

Ord index schema changes from 30 to 34. Release activation selects a separate versioned Ord directory, backs up the old node configuration and retains the old index. Enabled Ord rebuilds from existing Bitcoin blocks; Bitcoin, BH and USDB datasets are preserved.
Disabled Ord remains disabled, with no index creation. Default CPU, RAM and cache limits are unchanged; enabled upgrades require indexing time and space for both retained and new Ord indexes.
A release gate tests the pinned Ord and Bitcoin binaries for inscription creation, content and address APIs, canonical reorg recovery and restart persistence in isolated regtest.
operator_actions: Stop the node, install the new node kit, activate-release, then doctor and up. For enabled Ord, reserve disk for the new index and monitor minting-status until it catches up; retain the old directory and node.env.ord-upgrade-backup for rollback.
